feedback: Implementation meets AC-A1..A5, AC-B1..B4 and AC-C with all four hard gates green and an honest A5 reorder. To raise integration/maintainability next iteration: (1) Thread cfg.sellerId into the single-register/preview path (register/yahoo route + yahoo.ts:75 buildYahooItemImageUrls and yahoo.ts:48 caption buildYahooImgListHtml currently fall back to the okimarumarket hardcode); today this is only safe because the production seller equals okimarumarket, so a non-default seller would emit broken caption and item_image_urls in single register. Centralize the lib base so seller change touches one place (also lib-path.ts:18 publicUrl uses the static YAHOO_IMAGE_BASE). (2) Add one executor-level dry-run test that injects price=0 (or item_code with '_') end-to-end and asserts status=requires_manual with no upsert/editYahoo call, to cover AC-B4 directly rather than only via the generic 'validateYahoo missing' test. (3) Document that adding the B1-B3 value gates to the shared validateEditItemParams now also rejects such values in the existing single register/yahoo POST (400) — intended fail-fast hardening, but call it out so it is not mistaken for a regression.
risks: Caption imgList HTML (image-url.ts:36-43 buildYahooImgListHtml) and single-register item_image_urls (yahoo.ts:75) still use the okimarumarket hardcode; correct only because production seller == okimarumarket. A different sellerId would yield broken description and non-dynamic item_image_urls outside the migrate path.

B1-B3 value gates now also apply to the existing single register/yahoo POST via the shared validateEditItemParams, so previously-attempted items with price=0 / item_code containing '_' / non-numeric category now 400 there too (intended hardening, but a behavioral change beyond the migrate flow).
AC-B4 (value-range -> requires_manual in dry-run) is covered indirectly through the generic 'validateYahoo returns missing' executor test rather than a direct price=0 end-to-end case.
Live it-14091 final confirmation is out-of-loop (e2e_migrate --commit); offline gates cannot prove Yahoo-side propagation timing, only the ordering/uploaded-driven logic and retry.
recommended_next_changes: Pass cfg.sellerId through register/yahoo route and yahoo.ts (buildYahooItemImageUrls / buildYahooImgListHtml) so the lib base is dynamic everywhere, then remove reliance on the okimarumarket fallback; consolidate the base into one helper (also update lib-path.ts publicUrl).
Add an executor dry-run unit test injecting price=0 (and item_code '_') asserting status=requires_manual and no upsert/editYahoo call to cover AC-B4 directly.
Note in code/docs that validateEditItemParams value gates affect single register/yahoo, and consider whether single register should warn vs hard-400 to avoid blocking edge items.
Optionally surface img upload partial-failure indices (which image numbers succeeded) in MigrationItemResult for operator triage of remaining it-14091 cases.
